acceptance_criteria.label: Acceptance Criteria
acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria that must be met for issue completion

jql_templates.partial_search: project in ({projects}) AND (summary ~ "{query}" OR description ~ "{query}") ORDER BY updated DESC
jql_templates.users_search: project in ({projects}) ORDER BY updated ASC
jql_templates.assignee_search: project in ({projects}) AND assignee = "{username}" ORDER BY updated DESC
jql_templates.reporter_search: project in ({projects}) AND reporter = "{username}" ORDER BY updated DESC
jql_templates.assignee_reporter_search: project in ({projects}) AND assignee = "{assignee}" AND reporter = "{reporter}" ORDER BY updated DESC
jql_templates.release_search_all: project = "{project}" AND fixVersion = "{version}" ORDER BY created ASC
